question.text: A particle of mass <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>m</mi></math> moves in a circular orbit in a central potential field <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>U</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>r</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>U</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>.</mo></math> If Bohr's quantization conditions are applied, radii of possible orbitals <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>n</mi></msub></math> vary with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>n</mi><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>α</mi></mfrac></msup></math>, where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi></math> is _______ .
